_comment: Hand-written from docs/agentflow-integration.md (W7, E1-E7, Completeness), never generated. Executors are [kind, evidence, status, completeness, calls, labels]; workers make 2 calls each.

A-001._why: F1: H1 prompt-match, H2 window host via `agf start` with one unmatched owner submission; each launches a worker whose full runner result shares the tool call (strong chain). Every host turn has a proxy twin.

A-002._why: F13: a background launch read later by its handle is a strong chain; the Codex worker is read from the proxy.

A-003._why: F30: a runner-naming wrapper whose summary holds the clone path under `clone`.

A-004._why: F26: a reused caller-chosen clone, no chain; the earlier run is bound by its reflog and attributed by window, the later one is checkout unknown.

_footer: The proxy infers the Codex worker's parent (its temporal heuristic, a property of the input); Lineage ignores it and counts it (F6).
